name: The Bridge Watch
notes: Captain Hale's Watch at the Miners' Bridge (story bible §3.5, §5.2; mw-ju8.12). Friendly to the player and allied with each other and the townsfolk. Hostile to the unaligned faction, which is every creature that names no faction today, the Forgotten included: a monster is somebody the Watch turns away. Until the Forgotten get a faction of their own (mw-e13.17, mw-e40.18) this relation is how the table says so. The stance is data only: creatures do not yet choose other creatures as targets (the AI's one target is the player), so the guards stand and watch rather than fight; creatures never cross a scene transition either, which is what keeps monsters out of town.
